title: Reconcile immutable tagged installation identity on current main
rawUserRequest: 执行完整修复计划；自动执行并在每个 Contract 记录授权。修复真实 adopter 安装中选择 v0.5.48 却出现 v0.5.42/v0.5.32 的版本事实冲突。

rawRequestSource.reference: user-goal: execute full remediation plan with automatic authority

declaredIntent.summary: Bind tagged installer releases to one immutable fact bundle and diagnose contradictions.

outOfScope: Publishing a release or creating a semantic version tag.
Deleting or rewriting the stale release-install-identity worktree.
Weakening installer, release, or source-bound evidence checks.

sources.reason: Authoritative remediation request and acceptance criteria.
Quarantined stale predecessor; read-only implementation reference, never a merge base.

riskAssessment.reason: Installer metadata must be atomically bound to immutable release identity without accepting stale facts.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized full plan execution and supersession/quarantine; authority is recorded here.

preReviewWarnings: Treat the predecessor as read-only evidence; do not copy stale version facts without revalidation.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A conflicting selected tag, tag target, version metadata, manifest/release digest, or asset SHA-256 fails before installer lifecycle facts are written.
A successful tagged install atomically emits exactly one mutually consistent fact bundle that ai-cockpit-version can validate.
Stale metadata is not reused and rollback preserves the prior valid facts on a failed write.
Installer, upgrade, and status tests cover contradiction, success, stale-metadata, and rollback paths.
Distribution and installed-lifecycle documentation state the immutable identity contract.
guidelines: Fail closed on unverifiable external release facts.
Write lifecycle fact bundles atomically; never reuse stale version metadata.
Keep installer behavior project-neutral and document public commands.

intent.problem: Real adopter installation selected v0.5.48 but exposed conflicting v0.5.42/v0.5.32 facts. The original #611 Work Item is stale and dirty, so it is quarantined as read-only evidence.
constraints: Use current origin/main as the only implementation base.
Do not modify the quarantined predecessor.
Do not publish or tag a release in this Work Item.
Record the user's automatic-execution and supersession authority in this Contract.
intent.rationale: Immutable tag, commit, manifest, and asset-digest binding removes multiple installation truths and makes diagnostics reproducible.

scenarioCoverage.expected: One atomically bound identity and version fact bundle validates.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: failed lifecycle write retains valid prior facts
scenarioCoverage.expected: No partial new identity facts survive a failed write.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add rollback and failed-write regression tests.
